title: Benchmark Inflation: Revealing LLM Performance Gaps Using Retro-Holdouts

live_model.evidence: 'We also implement a variation of this test using GPT-4o as the evaluator to compare human and model performance' (Human Indistinguishability survey sub-study); results table lists GPT-4o '(24.05.13)' as an evaluator condition

prompt.location: Appendix C.2 (main TruthfulQA/Retro-Misconceptions prompt); Appendix F (human/GPT-4o indistinguishability survey methodology)

claim.metric: none for GPT-4o itself (it is used only as an automated stand-in evaluator for the human-indistinguishability survey, not scored on the benchmark)

data.source: TruthfulQA; the paper's new RETRO holdout sets (e.g. Retro-Misconceptions)

notes: The paper's actual retro-holdout benchmark results (Table 1) are reported for legacy OpenAI completion models (Babbage-002, Davinci-002) and NeoX-20b, none of which are on the live list; GPT-4o's only role is as an evaluator in a separate human-indistinguishability sub-study.
